verdict.rationale: Ente's own site says Auth has apps for mobile, desktop and web, and that 'your codes sync across all your devices, end-to-end encrypted,' backed by its encrypted cloud backup service. A Flathub desktop release and a community user who moved to it for desktop access after Authy dropped its desktop app support the multi-device claim. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how sync works (timing, conflict handling), explicit mention of tablets, independent hands-on confirmation that sync happens automatically and in real time.
